current.label: v1.3.0 — single claim-time protocol fee (0.30% on the escrowed gross), escrow holds full grossPayout (settlement excess flows to the merchant, or back to the payer on refund), 7-day refund window enforced on-chain (RefundWindowExpired). Adds zero-amount invoice rejection, delegate-expiry validation and recordPayerRefund payInToken binding.

config.feeRecipientNote: Documentary only — the contract has no on-chain feeRecipient. withdrawFees(token,to) is DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE-gated with the destination supplied at call time. This (leaked) EOA was de-privileged 2026-05-17 and cannot withdraw.
